description: This file defines the HeartbeatStore class, which manages heartbeat events, including observing notifications and fetching last heartbeat data asynchronously.

classes.name: HeartbeatStore
classes.description: A singleton class that stores and manages the latest control heartbeat event, observing notification center events and fetching data asynchronously.

methods.name: HeartBeatStore() (initializer)
methods.description: Initializes the HeartbeatStore, sets up observer for control heartbeat notifications, and attempts to fetch the last heartbeat asynchronously if not already available.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Removes the notification observer when deallocating the HeartbeatStore instance.
